text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $85k with modest gains while Ethereum lags slightly behind at $2,694, suggesting traders are rotating cautiously rather than committing aggressively to either major. The Fear & Greed index at 65 (Greed) coupled with rising BTC dominance at 58.6% points to confidence in bitcoin's relative strength, though the 7-day decline in sentiment hints that enthusiasm may be cooling. Volume remains moderate at $44B and smaller caps like BNB and SOL are outpacing the majors, indicating selective risk-taking rather than broad market conviction.
